newFindings.finding: Recorded verified ['built-in-battery'] only. Live page: 'If you can't fully charge the battery, you can use it plugged in to a power outlet' and 'The pump is still operable ... when plugged into an external power source'. Mains operation is stated but missing.

List-valued attributes (powerSources, portability, collection) carry no completeness flag. A verified ['built-in-battery'] reads as 'battery only' even when the page lists an AC adapter (S1 Plus, 9 Plus, S3 Pro, Pearl, Z2, Luna with Battery, Duo). The rule 'a charger is not mains' fixed false positives but created unflagged incompleteness.

collection='in-bra-wearable' (defined as self-contained, no external unit) is verified from the product name or 'fully wearable' wording only. The word 'wearable' does not by itself establish 'no external unit'. Live re-check: GLO page supports it in other lines; S12 Pro Quick page does not (only a customer review). These 11 values drive 11 'wearable' classifications. This is the I-09 pattern moved from category to collection.

weight is unknown, but the live product region states 'Under-2-pound and small design' and 'Rechargeable battery & under-2-pound design' (the sibling Pro+ Hands-free records lt 2 lb from equivalent wording). The unknown-with-signal verifier has no weight pattern. Related, rule-excluded: eufy S2 Pro 'Battery Life: 6.5 Hour' and capacity sit in a comparison block headed by the S2 Pro column.
Stored value lists three modes; the live page says 'four pumping modes and 30 total settings' and lists 'Classic Stimulation with 6 levels' as the fourth.

Composite cleaning strings contain content not in their stored quotes. Roam's value 'Boil parts 5 minutes ...' drops the source exclusion 'everything except the motor and tubing'; Aura Glow's '(except motor)' is supported only by an unquoted adjacent line.

parts='all' means 'all parts the source calls parts' (Willow 360: 'two parts to clean ... both are dishwasher-safe'), not the device; 'unspecified' (e.g. PIS Pro 'Only 4 parts to clean and dishwasher safe') has no component scope. Grounding passes these as verified objects with no definition, so 'the pump is dishwasher safe' is an easy misreading.

Qualifiers lost from structured values: Stride 'up to -300 mmHG in a single cup set up' stored as plain up-to 300; Luna with Battery 'up to 4+ hours' stored as up-to 240 (the '+' is a lower bound, and 'over 2 hours' / '4+ hours' are compatible, so the recorded conflict is questionable); Thrive capacity 6 oz applies to the hands-free cups only (box also has 5 oz bottles).

Anti-backflow wording is 'inferred' for SG and Momcozy V1/V2 but 'verified' for Zomee Fit (own page: 'anti-backflow system') and W1 (only evidence is the brand-wide Z2 statement 'fully enclosed, anti-backflow system').

classifyProduct treats multiUser=unknown as not multi-user. 55 of these 67 are classified into personal-use electric categories (23 flange-bottle, 22 wearable, 10 hands-free) that drive coverage, and basis ['mechanism','collection'] does not disclose the assumption.

Evenflo Advanced vs Deluxe Advanced have identical established facts (documented in DATA.md). eufy S2 vs S2 Pro carry identical suction/noise/cleaning quotes. Neither pair is distinguishable from catalog facts, and grounding does not say so.

Elvie Pump page sells Single and Double configurations under one record (includedItems describes one configuration). Momcozy S9 Pro page title says 'S9 Pro ... Upgraded'; M5 URL says 'upgraded-with-app-control'. Model names may not match the specific edition quoted.

11 of 54 adversarial payload checks fail: rules do not explain comparators, sessions-vs-minutes, dishwasher part scope, list completeness or noise comparability; variantOf is not exposed; classification basis hides the multiUser assumption; identical sibling records are not flagged. No unknown, inferred or conflicting value is promoted to verified.
DATA.md says S9 Pro battery is stated only as sessions, but batteryLife is verified 270 min. DATA.md cites 191 simulated quotes; the provider returns 188 (4 plans x 47 offerings).

Live product regions from region.py include retail prices and insurance calls-to-action (e.g. '$175.94 Sale', '$169.99', 'Get ... Through Insurance', 'available for purchase through insurance only'). No such text is in any product record today, but the extraction region is not commerce-free.
Manual silicone pump coded collection='in-bra-wearable', whose definition is 'motor + collector'. Classification is still correct (manual wins), but the value contradicts the schema definition.

selection.method:
Reproducible stratified sample of 30 verified attributes for the trust audit.
Population: every (product, attribute) with status "verified" (618), minus the 20 attributes
sampled in docs/CATALOG_AUDIT.md (S01-S20) and the 10 targeted re-check attributes (T01-T10).
Allocation: 30 slots across brands proportional to each brand's verified-attribute count,
minimum 1 per brand (largest-remainder rounding). Within a brand: random.Random(SEED) shuffle of
the brand's eligible attributes sorted by (product id, attribute); take in order, skipping any
product that already has 2 picks. Seed = 20261110 (audit date).
